facts: Entitlement: Party holder, typed right definition and scope, exact quantity/unit, half-open validity and optional predecessor
Obligation: Party obligated party, typed requirement and scope, exact quantity/unit and due time
Append-only EntitlementEnd and ObligationEnd: unique named terminal facts with effective time, reason and recording actor
operations: Entitlements.issue; recordObligation; revoke; expire; renew (independent successor grant)
entitlementPipAuthorizer delegates live facts to independent Gatekeeper policy
invariants: Business Party identity, participation, entitlement and authorization are distinct
Append-only grants, duties and terminal facts retain history; one successor and one terminal event per named fact
Quantities are nonnegative exact decimal<6> strings with paired explicit unit; no conversion, balance or consumption accounting
Validity is half-open; expiry is authoritative without an expiry audit row; explicit expiry records exactly validUntil
Renewal is independent issuance for the same holder/right/scope/unit after a finite predecessor term; predecessor revocation does not cascade to successors
Source and condition semantics live in typed upper-layer satellites; no policy language or generic source pointer
PIP facts and representation are read with tenant-scoped explicit policy, paginated and refreshed on every decision

acceptance.description: quantity/scoped-right support without becoming a ledger
